variables.name: brand/primary/800
variables.description: Financial → color/navy/800 · Invest → color/violet/800. Not for direct component use.

variables.name: color/control/checked
variables.description: Checked state of checked-type controls: Checkbox checked and indeterminate, Radio selected, Switch On (fill/border). Maps to checked / aria-checked. 10.5:1 on white. Selection of options, tabs or rows uses color/selection/*, not this token.

variables.name: border-width/default
variables.description: Standard width for any visible edge: inputs, cards, dividers, outlined buttons and overlay edges.

variables.name: color/elevation/shadow-overlay
variables.description: Shadow colour of elevation/overlay (menus, popovers, Listbox). Consumed through the effect style, not directly.

variables.name: font/line-height/body/md
variables.description: Line height for the default body text role. Also sets the height of the wrapper that aligns selection controls with the first line of their label.

variables.name: font/line-height/heading/xl
variables.description: Line height for the heading/xl text role; use only with font/size/heading/xl.

variables.name: font/size/body/md
variables.description: Default font size for body copy and input content, including inside small controls.

variables.name: font/size/heading/xl
variables.description: Font size for the most prominent heading style. Visual size is independent of heading level, which is set in code. Reduces at smaller breakpoints.

variables.name: layout/margin
variables.description: Minimum page-edge spacing outside the main content container; also used as the layout grid's outer offset.

variables.name: radius/full
variables.description: Fully rounded ends for circular or pill-shaped controls, e.g. Radio and Switch. Use instead of a large fixed radius.

variables.name: radius/max
variables.description: End of the radius scale (fully rounded). Index-based radius scale: radius/100 = 4px; "max" avoids a false numeric reading. Semantic alias: Dimension radius/full.

variables.name: radius/md
variables.description: Prominent action controls and raised or contained surfaces, e.g. Buttons and the Listbox overlay.

variables.name: size/control/height/md
variables.description: Default height for interactive controls (Button, Icon Button, Text Field, Select). Use unless the restricted small or prominent large height applies. Acts as a minimum when content wraps.

variables.name: space/gap/md
variables.description: Gap between a selection control and its label (Checkbox, Radio, Switch).
